pin_regs.reason: RTL registers every seam/pin explicitly (children: input pin flops or the wrapped module's first stage; outputs flop-driven). No extra wrapper edges.

name: qkd_ctrl_pc_port_nc1
structural_change: KV-NCKITS 10-17 (coordinator decision 3, KV-PLAN-CI 2e2d12f42): ci-less successor of the closed qkd_ctrl_pc_port_s3 (qkd_ctrl_pc_port_child): the W-face kw_vi / kw_di KV write data pins and their pin flops (cv_q / cdata_q) are removed; the port is ot_qfd_emb_pcport_nkw (KVW 2 without kw_v / kw_d). Same outline, faces, recipe and pin rules as qkd_ctrl_pc_port_s3; every pin stays registered at the pin (flop-first in/out, hrst captured by a pin flop); 0 normal-cycle delta (lockstep vs the original with ci held 0).
slot_change_request: Drop-in for qkd_ctrl_pc_port_s3: same slot and faces; only the legacy ci / co pass-through pins are gone.
